sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 8 (check 7) and Internal Quality Checks row 8 (same text, no extra annotation or cell comment)
rules/projects/webdev-task-template: instruction.md, tests/scoring.toml, tests/tools/score.py (diffed against the task copies: identical)
task/solution/app/server.js and src/custom-editor.js (size and spot check only)
qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/raw-evidence-index.json (all 22 artifact SHA256 values recomputed and matching)
evidence: Smallest submission satisfying the brief is a real full-stack build from an empty workspace. task/instruction.md: 'there is no starter app to finish'; environment/Dockerfile creates /app with only .gitkeep and seed_data.json has 'snippets': [] , so no trivial tweak of supplied code exists. The six notes require an own-implemented editing surface (ui.md: 'Don't use a textarea, input or contenteditable element as the document surface, and don't use CodeMirror, Monaco, Ace ...'), multi-caret editing with atomic undo, literal find/replace, JS and HTML formatting, an isolated preview with a five-second budget, Stop and last-good restore (behaviour.md), a network and parent-page boundary plus refusal of dynamic evaluation (security.md), and SQLite revisions with stale-save refusal, idempotent restore and live library refresh that survive a process restart (behaviour.md, integration.md). The golden is about 2,100 source lines (custom-editor.js 1284, runtime.ts 408, server.js 171, app.tsx 176). The reward cannot be reached by a stub: scoring.toml and score.py (identical to the frozen template) give reward 0 unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05. Gates: cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing (real key presses must appear in the editor), cw_custom_document_surface (fails a textarea, input, contenteditable or a ready-made editor root, 'including a transparent one layered over a highlighted copy'), cw_shared_saved_record (snippet must be found with exact title, filename and source after origin browser storage is cleared and after two reloads, which excludes a browser-only mock). Functional holds 43 binary criteria, total weight 59.0, each driven with real keys and mouse and mostly carrying a positive control, so a dead feature cannot pass a negative; app_context.md states 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work'. Broken-app attempts: (a) static page or textarea/CodeMirror wrapper: 0 by render or constraints gate; (b) pretty shell with labelled controls, a typing-only div editor and localStorage saving: 0 by cw_shared_saved_record; (c) typing-only own surface plus a real server save but no undo, navigation, Run or history: passes gates but clears no functional criterion (the cheapest ones need Delete plus keyboard Undo, sticky-column navigation, or revision and history across a restart), so functional 0 <= 0.05 and reward 0 despite any polish or visual credit. A conforming alternative is not excluded by this row: layout, labels, routes, schema, canvas/SVG/DOM surface and formatter library are free (policy.md, ui.md) and criteria allow them (canvas path in app_context.md and both colouring criteria). Runtime evidence: scripted golden results exist for these bytes (index limitation: produced on the previous commit, differing only in one judge-prompt paragraph); the hosted run (Oracle 0.9833, nop 0, one model 0 on a failed render gate) is on an EARLIER candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes. This row is judged on the ask and the scoring structure, which do not depend on that missing run.
notes: Note (not a defect, template policy): the functional floor is 0.05, i.e. more than 2.95 of 59.0 weight. A modest but genuine build (own text model with arrows, Delete, keyboard Undo, plus SQLite revisions and history) could pass about three cheap criteria, for example cw_custom_typing_and_line_join 1.0, cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers 1.0 and cw_save_reload_restart 1.5 = 3.5/59 = 0.059, and then also collect polish and visual credit, for an estimated reward near 0.15 to 0.2 without any Run, formatting or multi-caret support. That is real build work, not a stub, and partial credit is the intended shaped reward; the floor value is template-controlled and must not be edited. The estimate is reasoning, not a measured score.

Note: no configured judge run, nop run or weak-app discrimination run exists for these exact bytes. The nop 0 and model 0 results are from an earlier candidate whose render gate was stricter (it required Run); the present render gate is load-and-type only, so the exclusion of dead apps now rests on cw_shared_saved_record and the functional floor, which is sound on reading but unmeasured here.
